name: print-social-blue-health-and-care-post-variant-with-torn-paper-strips-and-group-photos
title: Blue Health and Care Variant with Paper Strips
whatItIs: A stock preview strip showing a blue variant of the health-care set: a pale post with a headline and two tilted polaroid-style photos of doctors and a text card, a blue post with a big white 'HEALTH & CARE' over stacked paper strips of copy and a partly visible third post, over a lilac page captioned 'Images not included'.
whatItMeans: Torn paper strips and tilted photo cards give a friendly, handmade layer to a clinical topic.
techniques: Heavy caps headline on a mid-blue field
Pale and saturated versions of one layout
Small logo and contact row at the base

vocabulary.definition: A narrow band of paper texture holding a line of text.
A tilted photo with a white border.
A copy of a layout in a different palette.
